method: Read publicly drawn hands into blank hour/minute/second fields. Fine readings separate the last large mark and remaining small marks before addition.
invariants: Only public diagram values used; hidden answers and expressions do not define teaching.
Original question quantities, signatures and curriculum minute resolution retained.
Fixed five-minute/five-second interval and twelve-as-zero rules are concepts, not prefilled computed results.
References contain only earlier checked learner values.
Obsolete drafts reset; checked partial drafts restore.
samples: Each primitive clock unit: 1200 generated samples with at least 100 distinct public clock drawings. This does not mean 100 different prompts, answers, facts or an authored problem bank.
limits: Tests and normal-UI evidence are separate.
No assertion of physical-device, learner-comprehension or release readiness.
